question: Which five pavement-marking colors are permitted by the general MUTCD color rule?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The evidence provided does not contain the general MUTCD pavement-marking color rule (i.e., the Standard that enumerates the permissible marking colors). The available text covers the 13-color code for traffic control devices generally (Section 1D.05), sign dimensions, and colored pavement provisions (yellow-colored and red-colored pavement), none of which states the five permitted pavement-marking colors. I cannot answer the question from this evidence without inventing content. Standards (mandatory): - The closest related provision is the general device color code: "The general meaning of the 13 colors shall be as follows: A. Black-regulation B. Blue-road-user services guidance… K. Red-stop or prohibition L. White-regulation M. Yellow-warning" — but this addresses the meanings of 13 colors for traffic control devices, not the five colors permitted for pavement markings. - Colored-pavement provisions in evidence are limited in scope: "If used, yellow-colored pavement shall be limited to: A. Flush or raised median islands separating traffic flows in opposite directions, B. Left-hand shoulders of divided highways, and C. Left-hand shoulders of one-way streets or ramps." and "If used, red-colored pavement shall be applied only in lanes, areas, or locations where general-purpose traffic is not allowed to use, queue, wait, idle, or otherwise occupy the lane, area, or location where red-colored pavement is used." These govern colored pavement, not the general pavement-marking color rule. Visual evidence: [Image 2] (Figure 3H-4) shows examples of green-colored pavement applications for bicycle facilities, which concerns colored pavement rather than the general marking-color rule; the remaining images ([Image 1], [Image 3]–[Image 8]) address sign colors, retroreflectivity, compliance dates, and tables of contents, and do not show the pavement-marking color rule. Citations: - Section 1D.05 Standard §2 (p.33) - Section 3H.04 Standard §2 (p.623) - Section 3H.07 Standard §3 (p.626) - Figure 3H-4 (p.626)
